title: Phyn Plus Reading Flow Rate Leaderboard
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=phyn:plus flow_gpm=*
| stats sum(flow_gpm) as total_value, avg(flow_gpm) as avg_value by fixture_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks fixture values by total and average flow rate across Phyn Plus reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `flow_gpm` values for each Phyn Plus reading event and review total and average flow rate by fixture.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total flow rate.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises which fixture shows the biggest flow rate numbers in your Phyn Plus reading data.
